name: nixos-vps
description: Remote component adapter for the shared nixos-vps implementation. Unreleased.

flakeDirectory.description: Absolute local directory containing the consumer flake and flake.lock.

configuration.description: Attribute under nixosConfigurations, for example web.

installer.description: Absolute local flake package reference or explicit pinned installer flake URL.

sshPublicKeyPath.description: Absolute path to the deployment public key.

sshPrivateKeyPath.description: Absolute path to the deployment private key; keep it outside the flake.

sshHostKeyPrivatePath.description: Absolute path to the separate Ed25519 server host private key.

serverType.description: x86_64 CX, CPX or CCX plan; defaults to cpx22.

location.description: Hetzner location code; defaults to nbg1.

bootstrapImage.description: Ubuntu or Debian bootstrap image; defaults to ubuntu-24.04.

existingSshKeyIds.description: Optional registered deployment SSH key IDs; omit to register a key.

sshSourceIps.description: Allowed SSH sources; include the deployment runner. Defaults to public IPv4/IPv6.

tcpPorts.description: Additional inbound TCP ports. The NixOS firewall must also allow them.

sshTimeoutSeconds.description: SSH readiness timeout in seconds, between 1 and 3600; defaults to 600.

ipv4.description: IPv4 address, resolved only after initial installation and SSH readiness.

nixos-vps:hetzner:NixosServer.description: Creates a fresh server, SSH key and firewall, then performs one initial NixOS installation. Routine updates use nixos-rebuild.
